items.name: 中文口播（母语听感，盲审）
中文屏幕文字（PPT 式画面）

evidence: Chapter card "What's confirmed"
issues.fix: "Confirmed vs. reported" (if the card can change; otherwise keep)
issues.orig: Chapter card "What's confirmed"
issues.problem: Chapter runs l10–l23 and spends l15–l23 on unconfirmed reports, responses and unknowns; the card promises only the first third. Eyebrows mitigate it, so not blocking.
issues.suggest: "Confirmed vs. reported" (if the card can change; otherwise keep)
issues.solution: 英文章名改「Confirmed vs. reported」：package.json chapters.c1.en 与 script.en.md s1 段标题行同步（只动这一行）；s1 页眉从 package.json 读

evidence: "No claim he quit over it"
issues.fix: "We’re not saying he quit over it" if the author wants a full voice
issues.orig: "No claim he quit over it"
issues.problem: Clipped; "it" resolves only via the h1 above. Passes, not a wince.
issues.suggest: "We’re not saying he quit over it" if the author wants a full voice
issues.solution: l09 改「We’re not saying he quit over it」

evidence: "Against her: insufficient evidence"
issues.fix: "Insufficient evidence against her" (4 words)
issues.orig: "Against her: insufficient evidence"
issues.problem: Clipped, "Against her" dangles; l28 uses the same pattern ("Her / insufficient evidence"), so keep the two consistent when changing.
issues.suggest: "Insufficient evidence against her" (4 words)
issues.solution: l22 改「Insufficient evidence against her」

issues.problem: Colon reads as a ratio; narration says "77 to 20".
issues.solution: 英文 l41 改「77–20」（en dash，仍是一个文字块）；中文保留「77 : 20」

evidence: "Mar 2026 · one senator per party"
issues.fix: "Mar 2026 · One senator per party"
issues.orig: "Mar 2026 · one senator per party"
issues.problem: Lower-case "one" after the dot, unlike the other eyebrows.
issues.suggest: "Mar 2026 · One senator per party"
issues.solution: 眉标改「Mar 2026 · One senator per party」

evidence: "Go after Commerce" / "Aim at Trump"
issues.fix: "Target Commerce" / "Target Trump"
issues.orig: "Go after Commerce" / "Aim at Trump"
issues.problem: Different verbs for the two parallel cards.
issues.suggest: "Target Commerce" / "Target Trump"
issues.solution: 两张卡统一动词：「Target Trump」/「Target Commerce」

evidence: "Filed Nov 9" tag
issues.fix: Add right padding, or shorten to "Nov 9"
issues.orig: "Filed Nov 9" tag
issues.problem: Touches the right edge of its card (s4_l57), unlike the two tags above it.
issues.suggest: Add right padding, or shorten to "Nov 9"
issues.solution: 英文 l57 清单卡加宽到 1080px（left 420），「Filed Nov 9」标签不再贴卡边（截图核过）

evidence: "Direct cause: likely governance"
issues.fix: "Direct cause: maybe governance"
issues.orig: "Direct cause: likely governance"
issues.problem: Narration hedges more: "may well be governance". "Likely" is a notch stronger.
issues.suggest: "Direct cause: maybe governance"
issues.solution: 改「Direct cause: may well be governance」，与口播 may well be 同样留余地

evidence: "True or false: already treated as national security"
issues.fix: "Either way: national security" (4 words)
issues.orig: "True or false: already treated as national security"
issues.problem: Near-verbatim compression of the narration (8 words, 8 s); acceptable but the longest line on a 19-word screen.
issues.suggest: "Either way: national security" (4 words)
issues.solution: l65 底行改「Either way: treated as national security」（6 词）

evidence: "The line: drawn by the product"
issues.fix: "Where privacy ends: the product decides" (6 words)
issues.orig: "The line: drawn by the product"
issues.problem: Narration says "Where his private life ends isn't up to him. What his company sells decides it." It never says "line"; on screen "The line" has no antecedent (the h1 above is "Critical product, less private life"). Label-colon passive fragment on a strict outro screen. This is the same "line" problem R2 fixed in the narration (I42), now moved onto the slide.
issues.suggest: "Where privacy ends: the product decides" (6 words)
issues.solution: l67 改「Where privacy ends: the product decides」，不再出现口播没有的 line

evidence: "Congress / Date not set"
issues.fix: "Huang testifies / Date not set" (parallel with "Probes / No conclusions yet")
issues.orig: "Congress / Date not set"
issues.problem: Date for what? Narration: "no date yet for him to go before Congress". Row label alone reads as Congress itself has no date.
issues.suggest: "Huang testifies / Date not set" (parallel with "Probes / No conclusions yet")
issues.solution: 第二行值改「His visit: no date」（标签列宽放不下 Huang testifies；不用 testify，众院请求的是闭门简报）。另：英文 l69 比 sd4 素材（6 秒上限）长，片段在句末前已淡出，所以英文截图没有听证席；片段开始点从 l69 开口挪到 l69 的 20% 处，中英两版句末都在画面里（截图核过）

evidence: 辞去 CEO · 董事 · 立即生效
issues.fix: 左标「辞去」，主行「CEO 和董事」，「立即生效」做行尾小标签
issues.orig: 辞去 CEO · 董事 · 立即生效
issues.problem: 「立即生效」不是「辞去」的宾语，三段用中点并列，语法层级混。
issues.suggest: 左标「辞去」，主行「CEO 和董事」，「立即生效」做行尾小标签
issues.solution: l02 主行改「CEO 和董事」，「立即生效」做行尾小标签

evidence: 安全、机密受损：暂无理由认为
issues.fix: 无理由认为安全、机密受损（12 字）
issues.orig: 安全、机密受损：暂无理由认为
issues.problem: 语序倒装，「受损」后面才补「暂无理由认为」，一眼读不顺；口播是「没理由认为国家安全或公司机密受了损害」。
issues.suggest: 无理由认为安全、机密受损（12 字）
issues.solution: 改「暂无理由认为安全、机密受损」

evidence: 页眉「01 · 只是报道 · 未证实」+ 屏中「匿名信源报道 · 未证实」
issues.fix: 屏中文字改「《纽约时报》匿名消息」（9 字），页眉保持不变
issues.orig: 页眉「01 · 只是报道 · 未证实」+ 屏中「匿名信源报道 · 未证实」
issues.problem: 整屏仅有的两处文字意思相同，重复。
issues.suggest: 屏中文字改「《纽约时报》匿名消息」（9 字），页眉保持不变
issues.solution: 栏头标签改「《纽约时报》匿名消息」，页眉不变

evidence: 章名「哪些是真的」
issues.fix: 不动；或章名「真的、没证实的、不知道的」（过长，不推荐）
issues.orig: 章名「哪些是真的」
issues.problem: 章内后半段是未证实、各方回应、不知道的事，章名比内容窄；页眉已按内容换，不影响读屏。英文版 I2 作者已决定不改，同样处理即可。
issues.suggest: 不动；或章名「真的、没证实的、不知道的」（过长，不推荐）
issues.solution: 保留章名「哪些是真的」
issues.reason: 章名归讲稿作者；审稿人也建议不动（备选过长），l15 起页眉已按内容换

evidence: 未以间谍事由调查她
issues.fix: 没因间谍嫌疑查过她（9 字）
issues.orig: 未以间谍事由调查她
issues.problem: 「间谍事由」是书面语，口播是「从没因为间谍嫌疑查过」。
issues.suggest: 没因间谍嫌疑查过她（9 字）
issues.solution: 改「没因间谍嫌疑查过她」，与口播一致

evidence: 警方查过她：涉嫌申报不实
issues.fix: 另查：公司买服务器涉嫌虚报（12 字）
issues.orig: 警方查过她：涉嫌申报不实
issues.problem: 口播是「查过她别的事：她那家公司买服务器时涉嫌虚报」，屏幕把被查对象缩成「她」，丢了「公司」，「申报不实」也与口播「虚报」叫法不同（上一轮 l21 口播改过，屏幕没跟）。
issues.suggest: 另查：公司买服务器涉嫌虚报（12 字）
issues.solution: 改「另查：公司买服务器涉嫌虚报」，与口播 v1.4 一致

evidence: 美国出口管制 / 核查过
issues.fix: 「出口管制部门 / 来核查」，或不动
issues.orig: 美国出口管制 / 核查过
issues.problem: 行内两格合计 9 字，比同构行每项 ≤8 字的口径略大；总字数与块数达标。
issues.suggest: 「出口管制部门 / 来核查」，或不动
issues.solution: 「美国出口管制」改「美方出口管制」，行内合计 ≤8 字

evidence: 被怀疑转运 / 的客户；跟 CEO / 走得近的人
issues.fix: 被怀疑转手 / 的客户；CEO / 身边的人
issues.orig: 被怀疑转运 / 的客户；跟 CEO / 走得近的人
issues.problem: 口播是「客户被怀疑往中国转手」「还牵到 CEO 身边的人」，屏幕换成「转运」「走得近的人」，叫法不一致，「走得近」还比口播多一层暗示。
issues.suggest: 被怀疑转手 / 的客户；CEO / 身边的人
issues.solution: 改「被怀疑转手的客户」「CEO 身边的人」，与口播一致

evidence: 另一段关系 / 报道称有下属关系
issues.fix: l57「下属那段感情」，l60「报道称与下属有感情」，l18「另一段感情」
issues.orig: 另一段关系 / 报道称有下属关系
issues.problem: 口播一直说「跟下属有过感情」，屏幕用「关系」，叫法不一；l18 屏幕同样是「另一段关系」。
issues.suggest: l57「下属那段感情」，l60「报道称与下属有感情」，l18「另一段感情」
issues.solution: 叫法统一为「感情」：l18「另一段感情」、l57「与下属的感情」、l60「与下属的感情见报 / 当天接受辞职」（口播 v1.4 的 l60 只讲时间点，中文清单同步去掉「认了不忠」）

evidence: 卷进别人的争斗、付了代价（caption：只对了一部分）
issues.fix: h1「被卷进别人的争斗」，caption「属实，但无记录说他因此下台」（13 字，仍是 4 块 31 字内）
issues.orig: 卷进别人的争斗、付了代价（caption：只对了一部分）
issues.problem: 口播已改为「他确实被卷进了别人的争斗，但没有记录说他因此下台」。「付了代价」是口播没有的新说法，且暗示辞职就是代价，和本段「无记录说他因此下台」的结论冲突；「只对了一部分」口播里已不再出现。
issues.suggest: h1「被卷进别人的争斗」，caption「属实，但无记录说他因此下台」（13 字，仍是 4 块 31 字内）
issues.solution: l58 第二行改 h1「被卷进别人的争斗」+ 说明「属实，但无记录说他因此下台」，与口播 v1.4 一致；英文同步「True, but no sign it’s why he left」

evidence: 英特尔 · 2018 / 都没有（淡出）+ 国会 / 中国外交部 + 底部大句
issues.fix: 不动
issues.orig: 英特尔 · 2018 / 都没有（淡出）+ 国会 / 中国外交部 + 底部大句
issues.problem: 截图中淡出卡仍可读，全算时 6 块 32 字，按淡出为背景口径是 3 块；底部大句「「间谍」说法真假 → 已按国家安全处理」14 字，接近一整句，但仍是箭头式短语。
issues.suggest: 不动
issues.solution: 不动
issues.reason: 审稿人结论为不动：淡出卡按背景口径算 3 块，底句是箭头式短语

evidence: 画线的：公司卖的东西
issues.fix: 说了算的：公司卖的东西
issues.orig: 画线的：公司卖的东西
issues.problem: 片尾从严项。口播 l67 全句没有「画线」，「什么算私事、什么算公事，不是他自己说了算」；英文版第 2 轮已为同样理由去掉 line，中文屏幕没跟；「画线的：」是标签腔，听口播的观众对不上。
issues.suggest: 说了算的：公司卖的东西
issues.solution: l67 改「说了算的：公司卖的东西」，与口播 v1.4「是他公司卖的东西说了算」一致

evidence: 首份无黄仁勋财报
issues.fix: 首份没有黄仁勋的财报（10 字，仍在 16 字内；l69 行值 ≤8 字则用「首份没他的财报」）
issues.orig: 首份无黄仁勋财报
issues.problem: 串场 / 收尾区。标题体，「无」字书面，「无黄仁勋财报」连读是名词堆砌；口播是「第一份没有黄仁勋的财报」。读得懂，不算怪，故不升必改。
issues.suggest: 首份没有黄仁勋的财报（10 字，仍在 16 字内；l69 行值 ≤8 字则用「首份没他的财报」）
issues.solution: 改「首份没有黄仁勋的财报」（与口播一致；该行不再按同构行合算，l69 三行仍 ≤4 块）

evidence: was out as CEO and as a director, effective immediately
issues.fix: Jensen Huang, the co-founder, was out as CEO and off the board, effective immediately.
issues.orig: was out as CEO and as a director, effective immediately
issues.problem: Wire-news phrasing, acceptable in a news cold open (I28 kept, reason holds).
issues.suggest: Jensen Huang, the co-founder, was out as CEO and off the board, effective immediately.
issues.solution: 记录级
issues.reason: 审稿人判可接受，仅记录

evidence: Before we go on, let's separate what's confirmed from what's only been reported.
issues.fix: First, what's actually confirmed, and what's only been reported.
issues.orig: Before we go on, let's separate what's confirmed from what's only been reported.
issues.problem: "let's separate X from Y" is lecture tone; "Before we go on" has nothing to go on from right after a title card. Close to acceptable.
issues.suggest: First, what's actually confirmed, and what's only been reported.
issues.solution: 第 3 轮（最后一轮）建议级
issues.reason: 最后一轮只改必改与影响一遍听懂的条目；这些属措辞偏好，改了无法再经独立复审，且两项口播各维度已 ≥2

issues.fix: Vary one or two ("Next," "On the other side,").
issues.problem: Same opener four times, with "So" opening many more.
issues.suggest: Vary one or two ("Next," "On the other side,").
issues.solution: 记录级
issues.reason: 审稿人判可接受，仅记录

evidence: with an executive who reported to him / the report of another relationship
issues.fix: with someone who reported to him
issues.orig: with an executive who reported to him / the report of another relationship
issues.problem: "executive" was also the businesswoman at l17, so a listener may think it is the same person; "another relationship" is vague.
issues.suggest: with someone who reported to him
issues.solution: 记录级
issues.reason: 审稿人判可接受，仅记录

evidence: So was the affair in his letter with the businesswoman?
issues.fix: So was the affair he admitted to with the businesswoman?
issues.orig: So was the affair in his letter with the businesswoman?
issues.problem: "the affair in his letter" is a little clunky.
issues.suggest: So was the affair he admitted to with the businesswoman?
issues.solution: 记录级
issues.reason: 审稿人判可接受，仅记录

evidence: The evidence against her fell short, but police are still investigating the company itself.
issues.fix: The evidence against the businesswoman fell short, but police are still investigating her company.
issues.orig: The evidence against her fell short, but police are still investigating the company itself.
issues.problem: "her" is the businesswoman last named at l23, with the chips and Southeast Asia chain in between.
issues.suggest: The evidence against the businesswoman fell short, but police are still investigating her company.
issues.solution: 第 3 轮（最后一轮）建议级
issues.reason: 最后一轮只改必改与影响一遍听懂的条目；这些属措辞偏好，改了无法再经独立复审，且两项口播各维度已 ≥2

evidence: So here's the chain: the most critical chips, a customer suspected of rerouting them, and someone close to the CEO.
issues.fix: So you've got the top chips, a customer suspected of rerouting them, and someone close to the CEO.
issues.orig: So here's the chain: the most critical chips, a customer suspected of rerouting them, and someone close to the CEO.
issues.problem: Noun-phrase list read aloud; "here's the chain" is slide-speak; three heavy noun phrases in one breath.
issues.suggest: So you've got the top chips, a customer suspected of rerouting them, and someone close to the CEO.
issues.solution: l30 改 So you've got the top chips, ...

evidence: Now look at how everyone responded. They all pointed to the same thing.
issues.fix: Now notice how everyone responded. They all reached for national security.
issues.orig: Now look at how everyone responded. They all pointed to the same thing.
issues.problem: "same thing" is a teaser the next line answers; "look at" with audio only; "everyone" is vague.
issues.suggest: Now notice how everyone responded. They all reached for national security.
issues.solution: 第 3 轮（最后一轮）建议级
issues.reason: 最后一轮只改必改与影响一遍听懂的条目；这些属措辞偏好，改了无法再经独立复审，且两项口播各维度已 ≥2

evidence: The board cited reports that foreign intelligence had targeted him.
issues.fix: The board cited those foreign intelligence reports.
issues.orig: The board cited reports that foreign intelligence had targeted him.
issues.problem: Near-verbatim repeat of l12; fine as one item in the "everyone pointed to security" list but could be shorter.
issues.suggest: The board cited those foreign intelligence reports.
issues.solution: 记录级
issues.reason: 审稿人判可接受，仅记录

evidence: there's a popular take in Chinese commentary: that Huang was a casualty of America's partisan fight.
issues.fix: Speaking of the two parties, a popular take in Chinese commentary is that Huang was a casualty of America's partisan fight.
issues.orig: there's a popular take in Chinese commentary: that Huang was a casualty of America's partisan fight.
issues.problem: "a take: that…" is a written construction.
issues.suggest: Speaking of the two parties, a popular take in Chinese commentary is that Huang was a casualty of America's partisan fight.
issues.solution: 第 3 轮（最后一轮）建议级
issues.reason: 最后一轮只改必改与影响一遍听懂的条目；这些属措辞偏好，改了无法再经独立复审，且两项口播各维度已 ≥2

evidence: Hong Kong outlet HK01 says Hu Xijin, a well-known Chinese commentator, first claimed Democrats and the establishment were targeting Huang to get at Trump.
issues.fix: Hong Kong outlet HK01 says Hu Xijin, a well-known Chinese commentator, first claimed Democrats were going after Huang to get at Trump.
issues.orig: Hong Kong outlet HK01 says Hu Xijin, a well-known Chinese commentator, first claimed Democrats and the establishment were targeting Huang to get at Trump.
issues.problem: 9.6 s, two unfamiliar names plus "the establishment" (means little to this viewer) and a double hop (outlet says X claimed).
issues.suggest: Hong Kong outlet HK01 says Hu Xijin, a well-known Chinese commentator, first claimed Democrats were going after Huang to get at Trump.
issues.solution: l50 the Washington establishment（加地名帮助理解）；句长保留

evidence: In other words, at first he blamed the Democrats.
issues.fix: So first he blamed the Democrats, then both parties.
issues.orig: In other words, at first he blamed the Democrats.
issues.problem: After l51 ("changed his tune: casualty of vicious two-party fighting") "In other words" suggests it restates l51; it actually restates l50 and sets up the contrast.
issues.suggest: So first he blamed the Democrats, then both parties.
issues.solution: l52 改 So first he blamed the Democrats, then both parties.

evidence: The strongest case against us says national security is just noise, and he left over ordinary corporate governance.
issues.fix: Not everyone buys this. The strongest pushback says national security is just noise, and he left over plain corporate governance.
issues.orig: The strongest case against us says national security is just noise, and he left over ordinary corporate governance.
issues.problem: The chapter card is silent, so by ear this drops straight in after l58 with no bridge. "The strongest case against us" is debate-club written style; "ordinary corporate governance" is formal.
issues.suggest: Not everyone buys this. The strongest pushback says national security is just noise, and he left over plain corporate governance.
issues.solution: l59 加口头过渡 Not everyone buys this.

evidence: He admitted infidelity, then a relationship with a subordinate was reported, and the board accepted his resignation that very day.
issues.fix: He admitted cheating, then came a report about a subordinate, and the board accepted his resignation the same day.
issues.orig: He admitted infidelity, then a relationship with a subordinate was reported, and the board accepted his resignation that very day.
issues.problem: Passive "was reported"; "that very day" has no clear anchor.
issues.suggest: He admitted cheating, then came a report about a subordinate, and the board accepted his resignation the same day.
issues.solution: 第 3 轮（最后一轮）建议级
issues.reason: 最后一轮只改必改与影响一遍听懂的条目；这些属措辞偏好，改了无法再经独立复审，且两项口播各维度已 ≥2

evidence: 目前没理由认为国家安全……受了损害

issues.suggest: 但董事会也说了，目前看，国家安全和公司机密都没受影响。

evidence: 还有两条，只是《纽约时报》的匿名消息……
issues.fix: 另外还有两条传闻，是《纽约时报》引用匿名消息源说的，到现在都没证实。
issues.orig: 还有两条，只是《纽约时报》的匿名消息……

issues.suggest: 另外还有两条传闻，是《纽约时报》引用匿名消息源说的，到现在都没证实。
issues.solution: 第 3 轮（最后一轮）建议级
issues.reason: 最后一轮只改必改与影响一遍听懂的条目；这些属措辞偏好，改了无法再经独立复审，且两项口播各维度已 ≥2
